title: Proteomics -> Alzheimer's disease (plasma and CSF mass spectrometry)

plasma_ad.note: PLASMA, Alzheimer's disease (53) vs cognitively normal controls (36); DIA-NN protein groups from Orbitrap Astral (4,925 protein groups, many missing). Two acquisition batches (ctx meta 'batch'). Published plasma-MS AD/amyloid classifiers reach AUROC ~0.79-0.91. Small n: guard hard against overfitting.

csf_ad.note: CSF, clinical AD (49) vs clinical non-AD (88) from four cohorts (Berlin, Sweden, Magdeburg, Kiel; ctx meta 'site', plus 'age', 'sex'). Spectronaut DIA, ~1,500 protein groups. Bader et al. 2020 reported AUC ~0.9 using tau-defined labels; here the label is the CLINICAL diagnosis.
